items.title: 25.4 Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Drug Designing (dawa banane mein AI ka istemal) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichhle kuch decades (dahaiyon) mein bohat kam naye antibiotics bane hain, aur jo bane woh pehle se maujood antibiotics se thore hi different hain. Nayi drugs (dawaiyan) banane ke maujooda methods (tareeqe) bohat mehnge aur zyada time lene wale hain, aur aam tor par chemical activity ke narrow spectrum (chhote daire) tak limited hain. Saath hi aise cases barh rahe hain jin mein bimari phailane wale pathogens (jaraseem) aam antibiotics ke khilaf resistant (dawa ka asar na lene wale) ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka sentence ulta hai: “prevalent antibiotics become resistant to existing pathogens”. Antibiotics resistant nahi hote; pathogens (bacteria) antibiotics ke khilaf resistant ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Halicin: paanch kone wale 1,3,4-thiadiazole ring par H2N (oopar ring ka S, neeche N-N), jo beech wale S ke zariye paanch kone wale thiazole ring (oopar ring ka S, neeche baen N) se jura hai jis par NO2 hai.
blocks.caption: Halicin ka structure (banawat) (kitab ke page 142 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Halicin mein do five-membered rings hain: baen taraf 1,3,4-thiadiazole ring (is par H₂N laga hai) aur daen taraf thiazole ring (is par NO₂ laga hai). Beech wala S atom dono rings ko jorta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki halicin drawing mein dono five-membered rings ki oopar wali chotti par koi atom nahi likha, jis se lagta hai wahan carbon hai. Asal mein halicin ke dono rings mein wahan sulphur (S) hai; is liye hamari drawing mein dono rings mein S likha gaya hai.

Is problem (masle) ka solution (hal) dhoondne ke liye MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) ke researchers ne aik machine-learning algorithm banaya jo un chemical features (khoobiyon) ko dhoonde jo molecules ko E. coli bacteria maarne mein kaamyab banati hain. Is ke liye unhon ne model ko 2500 molecules aur 800 natural (qudrati) products ke aik set par chalaya, jin ke structures alag alag the aur bioactivities (jaandaron par asar) ki range bohat bari thi. Jab computer model in compounds par chalaya gaya to us ne aik aisa molecule chuna jis ke bare mein andaza tha ke woh bacteria ko maarega aur jis ka structure maujooda antibiotics se different hai.

Aik doosre model se researchers ne yeh bhi dikhaya ke yeh molecule insani cells ke liye shayad low toxicity (kam zehreela-pan) wala hoga. Baad mein is molecule ka naam Halicin rakha gaya aur ise mareezon se liye gaye bacteria ke kai strains (qismon) par aazmaya gaya. Pata chala ke is naye molecule ne duniya ke bohat se sab se mushkil bimari phailane wale bacteria maar diye jin par pehle ilaaj asar nahi karta tha.

Halicin pehchanne ke baad researchers ne apne computer model se aik database ke 10 crore (100 million) se zyada molecules screen kiye (jaanche). Yeh screening sirf teen din mein complete hui, aur model ne 23 aur aise molecules chune jin ke structures maujooda antibiotics se different hain. Researchers ne dekha ke in mein se aath molecules ne bacteria ke khilaf asar dikhaya aur do khaas tor par powerful (taqatwar) the. Is kaam ne dawa ke tor par istemal ho sakne wale naye organic molecules dhoondne ka bilkul naya raasta dikhaya hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Vitamin B₁₂ ki historic (tareekhi) total (mukammal) synthesis R. B. Woodward aur A. Eschenmoser ne 1972 mein 10 saal se zyada ke collaboration (mil kar kaam) ke baad ki. Is mein 100 se zyada steps the, aur 91 post-doctoral researchers aur 12 PhD students ne kaam kiya.

blocks.prompt: AI model ne kya kaam kiya jo lab mein aazmane se bohat dair leta?
blocks.explanation: Is ne bohat zyada molecules ka bacteria maarne wala asar (aur possible toxicity) pehle se predict kiya (andaza lagaya), teen din mein 10 crore se zyada molecules screen kiye, aur lab mein test karne ke liye Halicin jaise kuch candidates (umeedwar) chune.

items: Naye antibiotics kam ban rahe hain aur bacteria ki resistance barh rahi hai.
MIT ke machine-learning model ne Halicin dhoonda, jo resistant bacteria ko maarta hai.
3 din mein 10 crore se zyada molecules ki screening: 23 candidates, 8 asar wale, 2 bohat powerful.
